title: Wonderfully Me
bigIdea: God carefully made you, and you are wonderful.

memoryVerse.text: How you made me is amazing and wonderful.

moral.lesson: God made every single part of you on purpose — your face, your laugh, the way you think. There is no one else in the whole world exactly like you. You are not an accident; you are wonderfully made.
moral.application: When you feel like you wish you were more like someone else, remember God made YOU on purpose and loves who He made. You are wonderful just as you are.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: A warm, glowing scene of God's gentle care: a soft light shining down over a peaceful home where a happy baby is cradled, cozy and loved.
text: Long before you were born, God already knew all about you.
He planned for you and could not wait for you to be here.

beats.scene: A cheerful young child with short brown hair smiling and pointing happily at their own eyes, hands, and feet, in a bright friendly room.
text: God carefully made every part of you.
Your bright eyes, your happy smile, your wiggly fingers and toes — God made them all.

beats.scene: The same cheerful brown-haired child laughing joyfully and talking, with little musical notes and hearts floating around to show their unique voice and laugh.
text: God gave you your very own laugh and your very own voice.
He gave you your own way of thinking and the things you love to do.

beats.scene: A happy group of different children of many looks standing together, with the brown-haired child in the middle, each one unique and smiling.
text: There is no one else in the whole world exactly like you.

beats.scene: The cheerful brown-haired child standing proudly and happily with arms open, a warm glow around them, looking joyful and loved.
text: God made you carefully, on purpose, and with love.
